fields.name: Leather Goods

fields.name: Home Objects

fields.name: Eyewear
fields.description: Acetate and titanium frames, hand-finished.

fields.name: Meridian Automatic
fields.description: The Meridian Automatic pairs a 41mm brushed stainless case with a sapphire crystal and a 42-hour power reserve. A quiet, precise companion for daily wear.
fields.short_description: Swiss automatic movement in a brushed steel case.

fields.name: Solstice Chronograph
fields.description: Solstice brings motorsport styling to the wrist with a fully functional chronograph, luminous hands, and a quick-release strap.
fields.short_description: Three-register chronograph with a tachymeter bezel.

fields.name: Aline Minimal
fields.description: Aline strips the watch back to essentials: a domed crystal, a matte dial, and a strap made from apple-leather composite.
fields.short_description: A clean two-hand dial with a vegan leather strap.

fields.name: Northbound Field Watch
fields.description: Built for travel, Northbound has a matte titanium case, a high-contrast dial, and an interchangeable NATO strap.
fields.short_description: Rugged field watch with a scratch-resistant case.

fields.name: Aria Over-Ear Headphones
fields.description: Aria delivers a warm, balanced sound signature with 40mm drivers, active noise cancellation, and 30 hours of playback.
fields.short_description: Closed-back headphones with memory-foam ear cups.

fields.name: Ember Wireless Earbuds
fields.description: Ember auto-tunes itself to your ear shape for consistent bass and clarity, with a matte-ceramic charging case.
fields.short_description: True wireless earbuds with adaptive EQ.

fields.name: Cast Tabletop Speaker
fields.description: Cast fills a room evenly from a compact walnut cabinet, with a capacitive touch dial for volume and source switching.
fields.short_description: A single-driver speaker with a walnut enclosure.

fields.name: Drift Portable Speaker
fields.description: Drift is rated IPX5 and fits in a jacket pocket, with 14 hours of battery life and a fabric-wrapped shell.

fields.name: Harbor Weekender Bag
fields.description: Harbor is hand-stitched from a single hide, with a canvas interior, a detachable shoulder strap, and space for a two-day trip.
fields.short_description: Full-grain leather duffel with brass hardware.

fields.name: Fold Card Wallet
fields.description: Fold is cut from vegetable-tanned leather that darkens beautifully with age, finished with hand-burnished edges.
fields.short_description: A slim wallet that holds six cards and folded cash.

fields.name: Ledger Portfolio
fields.description: Ledger holds a notebook, loose pages, and a pen loop behind a magnetic flap, wrapped in pebbled leather.
fields.short_description: A5 leather portfolio with a magnetic closure.

fields.name: Waylon Belt
fields.description: Waylon switches between black and chestnut with a twist of the buckle, cut from a single strip of full-grain leather.
fields.short_description: A reversible belt with a brushed steel buckle.

fields.name: Pour Over Carafe Set
fields.description: A slow, deliberate way to make coffee: a hand-blown carafe, a reusable steel filter, and a walnut base that doubles as a trivet.
fields.short_description: Borosilicate carafe with a walnut collar.

fields.name: Anchor Desk Lamp
fields.description: Anchor casts warm, even light through a spun-aluminum shade, with a touch-dimmer built into a solid marble base.
fields.short_description: A dimmable task lamp with a marble base.

fields.name: Grove Ceramic Mug Set
fields.description: Each Grove mug is glazed individually, so no two are quite alike. Dishwasher and microwave safe despite the handmade finish.
fields.short_description: Set of two stoneware mugs, glazed by hand.

fields.name: Fold Wool Throw
fields.description: Woven from lambswool on a traditional loom, Fold is heavy enough for cool evenings and finished with a fringed edge.
fields.short_description: A lambswool throw, woven in a houndstooth check.

fields.name: Percy Round Frames
fields.description: Percy is cut from Italian acetate and finished by hand, with spring hinges for a comfortable, forgiving fit.
fields.short_description: Hand-polished acetate frames with a keyhole bridge.

fields.name: Dune Sunglasses
fields.description: Dune pairs a featherweight titanium frame with polarized, UV400 lenses in a gradient tortoise finish.

fields.name: Vista Reading Glasses
fields.description: Vista is built for screen time, with a blue-light filtering coating and a flexible titanium core inside the temples.
fields.short_description: Lightweight readers with a blue-light filter.
